title: nan
authors: Tang Y.; Zhang J.; Gong J.; Li Y.; Yang B.
key_contribution: Presents a Vision Transformer-based aerial-to-OpenStreetMap 2D map matching network fused with visual odometry via particle filtering for urban scale aerial geo-localization in GNSS-denied conditions.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
